name: @maploom/spatial-analysis-plugin
description: Spatial analysis widgets and actions backed by independent analysis services.
author: MapLoom

widgets.title: DBSCAN Clustering Panel
widgets.description: Configures and runs DBSCAN point clustering.

emits.description: Emitted when the user starts DBSCAN clustering.

widgets.title: Site Selection Panel
widgets.description: Configures and runs multi-criteria candidate-site ranking.

emits.description: Emitted when the user starts site-selection analysis.

widgets.title: POI Grid Analysis Panel
widgets.description: Configures and runs POI density grid analysis.

widgets.title: Urban Function Analysis Panel
widgets.description: Configures and runs urban functional-zone analysis.

actions.title: Run DBSCAN Clustering
actions.description: Calls a spatial analysis service and renders the clustered point result.

actions.title: Run Site Selection
actions.description: Ranks candidate sites and renders the evaluation result.

actions.title: Run POI Grid Analysis
actions.description: Calculates and renders POI density grids.

actions.title: Run Urban Function Analysis
actions.description: Identifies and renders urban functional zones.
